Verses.VerseAr: تَنۡزِيۡلُ الۡكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَكِيۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the Lord of Honour, All-Wise.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَ بِالۡحَقِّ فَاعۡبُدِ اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We have revealed (this) Book to you with the Truth. So worship Allah for His sake alone in sincere obedience.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَا لِلّٰهِ الدِّيۡنُ الۡخَالِصُ‌ؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖۤ اَوۡلِيَآءَ‌ۘ مَا نَعۡبُدُهُمۡ اِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُوۡنَاۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِ زُلۡفٰىؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِىۡ مَا هُمۡ فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ‌ ؕ  اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِىۡ مَنۡ هُوَ كٰذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Say to the people:) ‘Listen, sincere obedience and worship is only Allah’s due. And those (disbelievers) who have taken (idols as) helpers other than Allah (say in false justification of their idol-worship:) ‘We worship them only that they may bring us near to Allah.’ Surely Allah will judge between them concerning the matter in which they differ. Certainly Allah does not give him guidance who is a liar, very ungrateful.

Words.MeaningEn: that they may bring us near

Verses.VerseAr: لَّوۡ اَرَادَ اللّٰهُ اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّاصۡطَفٰى مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ‌ ۙ سُبۡحٰنَهٗ‌ؕ هُوَ اللّٰهُ الۡوَاحِدُ الۡقَهَّارُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Had Allah willed to beget children (for Himself), He would have chosen whom He liked out of His Creation. Glory be to Him, He is Allah, the One, the All-Dominant.

Verses.VerseAr: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَقِّ‌ ۚ يُكَوِّرُ الَّيۡلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى الَّيۡلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ‌ؕ كُلٌّ يَّجۡرِىۡ لِاَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى‌ؕ اَلَا هُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡغَفَّارُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He created the heavens and the earth with a zero-defect strategy and planning. He causes the night to overlap the day and the day to overlap the night. And He is the One Who has subjected the sun and the moon (to a system). Each (star and planet) rotates in its orbit till an appointed time. Beware! He is the One Who is All-Dominant (over the entire system), Most Forgiving.

Verses.VerseAr: خَلَقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ نَّفۡسٍ وَّاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَاَنۡزَلَ لَـكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَنۡعَامِ ثَمٰنِيَةَ اَزۡوَاجٍ‌ؕ يَخۡلُقُكُمۡ فِىۡ بُطُوۡنِ اُمَّهٰتِكُمۡ خَلۡقًا مِّنۡۢ بَعۡدِ خَلۡقٍ فِىۡ ظُلُمٰتٍ ثَلٰثٍ‌ؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ الۡمُلۡكُ‌ؕ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ‌ۚ فَاَنّٰى تُصۡرَفُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He has created all of you from a single life cell, and then made from it a similar pair. And then He brought about for you eight living animals in pairs. He shapes you in the wombs of your mothers from one creative phase into the next in sequence and (completes this process) in three (germinal) layers. This is Allah, your Lord, to Whom belongs all Power and Authority. There is no God except He. Where then are you deviated (and disoriented after knowing these concealed realities of Creation)?

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنۡكُمۡ‌ وَلَا يَرۡضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ الۡكُفۡرَ‌ۚ وَاِنۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡا يَرۡضَهُ لَـكُمۡ‌ؕ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِّزۡرَ اُخۡرٰى‌ؕ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّكُمۡ مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: If you disbelieve then surely Allah is Self-Sufficient and He does not like disbelief (and ingratitude) for His servants and if you give thanks, (so) He likes it for you. And no bearer of burden will bear the burden of any other. Then you have to return to your Lord. Then He will inform you of the deeds which you used to do. Surely He knows best (even) the secrets of the hearts.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا مَسَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهٗ مُنِيۡبًا اِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ اِذَا خَوَّلَهٗ نِعۡمَةً مِّنۡهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدۡعُوۡۤا اِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلّٰهِ اَنۡدَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِهٖ‌ؕ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعۡ بِكُفۡرِكَ قَلِيۡلًا  ‌ۖ اِنَّكَ مِنۡ اَصۡحٰبِ النَّارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when some suffering afflicts man he turns towards his Lord and cries out. Then when (Allah) grants him some blessing from Himself, he forgets that (suffering) he used to beseech relief from. And (then) he sets up (idols) as partners with Allah to make (others also) lose His Way. Say: ‘(O disbeliever,) profit a little (worldly gain) from your disbelief; you are for sure of the inmates of Hell.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَانِتٌ اٰنَآءَ الَّيۡلِ سَاجِدًا وَّقَآٮِٕمًا يَّحۡذَرُ الۡاٰخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُوۡا رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهٖ‌ؕ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِىۡ الَّذِيۡنَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ وَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‌ؕ اِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ اُولُوا الۡاَلۡبَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Well! (Is this polytheist better or) that (believer) who worships during the hours of the night standing and in prostration, lives in fear of the Hereafter and expects Mercy from his Lord?’ Say: ‘Can those who have knowledge and those who do not have (all) be alike?’ So only the wise do receive the admonition.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ يٰعِبَادِ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا اتَّقُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ‌ؕ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اَحۡسَنُوۡا فِىۡ هٰذِهِ الدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٌ  ‌ ؕ وَاَرۡضُ اللّٰهِ وَاسِعَةٌ  ‌ ؕ اِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصّٰبِرُوۡنَ اَجۡرَهُمۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Beloved, say from My side:) ‘O My servants, you who have believed, adopt Godwariness; it is for these men of spiritual excellence in this world that there is excellent reward. And Allah’s earth is vast. So the steadfast will certainly be given their reward without measure.’

Words.MeaningEn: will be paid back in full

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اِنِّىۡۤ اُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اَعۡبُدَ اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘I have been commanded to worship Allah in sincerest obedience and devotion to Him alone.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاُمِرۡتُ لِاَنۡ اَكُوۡنَ اَوَّلَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And I was (also) commanded to become the first Muslim of all (His Creation).

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اِنِّىۡۤ اَخَافُ اِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّىۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘If I disobeyed My Lord, I would fear the torment of a Terrible Day.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلِ اللّٰهَ اَعۡبُدُ مُخۡلِصًا لَّهٗ دِيۡنِىۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘I worship Allah alone making obedience purely for Him.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاعۡبُدُوۡا مَا شِئۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ‌ؕ قُلۡ اِنَّ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ الَّذِيۡنَ خَسِرُوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَاَهۡلِيۡهِمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ‌ؕ اَلَا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡخُسۡرَانُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So worship what you like besides Allah.’ Say: ‘Surely losers are only those who will bring loss to their own souls and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Remember! That truly is the manifest loss.

Verses.VerseAr: لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ فَوۡقِهِمۡ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ النَّارِ وَمِنۡ تَحۡتِهِمۡ ظُلَلٌ ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللّٰهُ بِهٖ عِبَادَهٗ‌ؕ يٰعِبَادِ فَاتَّقُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: For them there will be clouds of fire (as covers) over them and pavements of fire beneath them too. This is (the torment) with which Allah warns His servants.’ O My servants! Always fear Me.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اجۡتَنَبُوۡا الطَّاغُوۡتَ اَنۡ يَّعۡبُدُوۡهَا وَاَنَابُوۡۤا اِلَى اللّٰهِ لَهُمُ الۡبُشۡرٰى‌ۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who remained intact from idol-worship and turned towards Allah, for them is good news. So give glad tidings to My servants.

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ يَسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ الۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُوۡنَ اَحۡسَنَهٗ‌ؕ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ الَّذِيۡنَ هَدٰٮهُمُ اللّٰهُ‌ وَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمۡ اُولُوا الۡاَلۡبَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who listen attentively to what is said, then follow the best in it, it is they whom Allah has given guidance and it is they who have wisdom.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَمَنۡ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِ كَلِمَةُ الۡعَذَابِؕ اَفَاَنۡتَ تُنۡقِذُ مَنۡ فِىۡ النَّارِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Well, can you save him for whom the Command of torment has become due and who has become the inmate of Hell (for ever)?

Verses.VerseAr: لٰـكِنِ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا رَبَّهُمۡ لَهُمۡ غُرَفٌ مِّنۡ فَوۡقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبۡنِيَّةٌ  ۙ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ‌ ؕ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ لَا يُخۡلِفُ اللّٰهُ الۡمِيۡعَادَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But for those who fear their Lord are lofty palaces (in Paradise) with lofty mansions built over and rivers flowing beneath. This is Allah’s promise. Allah does not go against His promise.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ اَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَسَلَـكَهٗ يَنَابِيۡعَ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُ بِهٖ زَرۡعًا مُّخۡتَلِفًا اَلۡوَانُهٗ ثُمَّ يَهِيۡجُ فَتَرٰٮهُ مُصۡفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهٗ حُطَامًا‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرٰى لِاُولِىۡ الۡاَلۡبَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O man!) Have you not seen that Allah showered water from the sky, then made it sprout from the earth as water springs? Then He brings forth with it crops of various colours. Then (growing fully) it dries up. Then, (ripening,) you see it turns yellow. Then He reduces it to broken straw. Surely there is advice in it for the wise.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَمَنۡ شَرَحَ اللّٰهُ صَدۡرَهٗ لِلۡاِسۡلَامِ فَهُوَ عَلٰى نُوۡرٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖ‌ؕ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلۡقٰسِيَةِ قُلُوۡبُهُمۡ مِّنۡ ذِكۡرِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Well, he whose breast Allah has opened for Islam is (stationed) in the light from his Lord. (But on the contrary) they whose hearts are hardened for (being deprived of the Bounty of) Allah’s remembrance are destined to ruin. It is they who are in open error.

Verses.VerseAr: اَللّٰهُ نَزَّلَ اَحۡسَنَ الۡحَدِيۡثِ كِتٰبًا مُّتَشَابِهًا مَّثَانِىَ ‌ۖ تَقۡشَعِرُّ مِنۡهُ جُلُوۡدُ الَّذِيۡنَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ‌ۚ ثُمَّ تَلِيۡنُ جُلُوۡدُهُمۡ وَقُلُوۡبُهُمۡ اِلٰى ذِكۡرِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ هُدَى اللّٰهِ يَهۡدِىۡ بِهٖ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ‌ؕ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ هَادٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah is the One Who has sent down the best Word. That is a Book whose contents are in harmony with one another (in format and meaning) and (whose Verses) are repeated frequently. It sends a hair-raising shudder in the bodies of those who fear their Lord. Then their skins and hearts get softened and they get (lost) into the Remembrance of Allah (in a weeping mood). It is guidance from Allah and He guides with it whom He wills. And he whom Allah holds misguided (i.e. leaves astray) has no one to guide him.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَمَنۡ يَّتَّقِىۡ بِوَجۡهِهٖ سُوۡٓءَ الۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ‌ؕ وَقِيۡلَ لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ ذُوۡقُوۡا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Well, on the Day of Resurrection, (what will be his plight) who will be trying to halt the evil torment (of the Fire) with his face (because both his hands will be fastened)? And it will be said to these wrongdoers: ‘Taste the consequence of the evil deeds that you used to do.’

Verses.VerseAr: كَذَّبَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَاَتٰٮهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The people who passed before them rejected (the Messengers), so the torment came upon them from where they had no perception.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَذَاقَهُمُ اللّٰهُ الۡخِزۡىَ فِىۡ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا‌ۚ وَلَعَذَابُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ اَكۡبَرُ‌ۘ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So Allah made them taste disgrace and humiliation (here) in this world and surely the torment of the Hereafter is far greater. Would that they knew!

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِىۡ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ مِنۡ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And truly, (to make the people understand,) We have given every kind of example in this Qur’an in order that they may take advice.

Verses.VerseAr: قُرۡاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِىۡ عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Qur’an is in the Arabic language (which is the most comprehensive, lucid and communicative of all the languages) in which there is not even a bit of crookedness so that they may adopt Godwariness.

Verses.VerseAr: ضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلاً رَّجُلاً فِيۡهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشٰكِسُوۡنَ وَرَجُلاً سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍؕ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيٰنِ مَثَلاً   ‌ؕ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ ‌ۚ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah has given an example of such a (slave) person that is owned by many partners who are ill-mannered and mutually quarrelsome as well. And (on the other side) there is a person who is a slave only to one master. Can they both be alike? (Not at all!) All praise belongs to Allah alone. But most of them do not know (the Truth of the Oneness of Allah).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَّاِنَّهُمۡ مَّيِّتُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O My Esteemed Beloved!) Surely you will pass away (only to taste death ) but they will certainly die (for everlasting death. So the difference between the two deaths will be worth seeing).

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكُمۡ تَخۡتَصِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then certainly on the Day of Resurrection you will dispute with one another in the Presence of your Lord. (One party will say to the other: ‘You stopped us from understanding the station of the Prophet and the glory of the Messenger.’ They will reply: ‘No, you were yourselves ill-fated and misguided.’)

Verses.VerseAr: فَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنۡ كَذَبَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدۡقِ اِذۡ جَآءَهٗ‌ؕ اَلَيۡسَ فِىۡ جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوًى لِّلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So who is more unjust than he who invents lies against Allah and denies the Truth when it comes to him? Is not the abode for disbelievers in Hell?

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِىۡ جَآءَ بِالصِّدۡقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهٖۤ‌ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡمُتَّقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And whoever has brought the Truth and he who has confirmed it, it is they who are Godfearing.

Verses.VerseAr: لَهُمۡ مَّا يَشَآءُوۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ جَزٰٓؤُ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَۚ ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (All) those (favours) which they will long for (are in store) for them with their Lord. This is the reward of those who are committed to (piousness and) spiritual excellence,

Verses.VerseAr: لِيُكَفِّرَ اللّٰهُ عَنۡهُمۡ اَسۡوَاَ الَّذِىۡ عَمِلُوۡا وَيَجۡزِيَهُمۡ اَجۡرَهُمۡ بِاَحۡسَنِ الَّذِىۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that Allah may remove from them errors which they did and may grant them the reward for the pious deeds they used to do.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَيۡسَ اللّٰهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهٗ‌ؕ وَيُخَوِّفُوۡنَكَ بِالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ‌ؕ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ هَادٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Is Allah not enough for His (most intimate) servant (the Esteemed Holy Prophet [blessings and peace be upon him])? And these (disbelievers) frighten you, apart from Allah, with the idols (which they worship). And there is no one to guide him whom Allah holds astray (owing to his denial to believe the Truth).

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَنۡ يَّهۡدِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ مُّضِلٍّ‌ؕ اَلَيۡسَ اللّٰهُ بِعَزِيۡزٍ ذِىۡ انتِقَامٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And he whom Allah blesses with guidance, there is none to misguide him. Is Allah not Almighty, the Lord of Vengeance?

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَٮِٕنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُ‌ ؕ قُلۡ اَفَرَءَيۡتُمۡ مَّا تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ اَرَادَنِىَ اللّٰهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلۡ هُنَّ كٰشِفٰتُ ضُرِّهٖۤ اَوۡ اَرَادَنِىۡ بِرَحۡمَةٍ هَلۡ هُنَّ مُمۡسِكٰتُ رَحۡمَتِهٖ‌ؕ قُلۡ حَسۡبِىَ اللّٰهُ‌ؕ عَلَيۡهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الۡمُتَوَكِّلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if you ask them: ‘Who has created the heavens and the earth?’ they will certainly say: ‘Allah.’ Say: ‘Well, state, can the idols that you worship besides Allah remove the suffering which Allah may intend to inflict upon me, or if Allah intends to grant me Mercy, can they (idols) stop that Mercy (sent by Him)?’ Say: ‘Allah is Sufficient for me. The trusting ones put their trust in Him alone.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡمَلُوۡا عَلٰى مَكَانَتِكُمۡ اِنِّىۡ عَامِلٌ‌ۚ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘O (my) people! Carry on working according to your way; I am working (according to my way). Then you will soon know (the end),

Verses.VerseAr: مَنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡهِ عَذَابٌ يُّخۡزِيۡهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (That) who it is upon whom comes the torment which will disgrace him. And everlasting torment will come down upon him.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالۡحَقِّ‌ ۚ فَمَنِ اهۡتَدٰى فَلِنَفۡسِهٖ‌ ۚ وَمَنۡ ضَلَّ فَاِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَا‌ ۚ وَمَاۤ اَنۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِوَكِيۡلٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely, We revealed the Book to you with the Truth for (the guidance of) people. So he who takes guidance takes for his own benefit, and he who goes astray, so he strays to his own detriment. And you are not responsible for them.

Verses.VerseAr: اللّٰهُ يَتَوَفَّى الۡاَنۡفُسَ حِيۡنَ مَوۡتِهَا وَالَّتِىۡ لَمۡ تَمُتۡ فِىۡ مَنَامِهَا‌ۚ فَيُمۡسِكُ الَّتِىۡ قَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهَا الۡمَوۡتَ وَيُرۡسِلُ الۡاُخۡرٰٓى اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah takes away souls at the time of their death and those whose death has not yet arrived during their sleep. Then He withholds those souls whose death He has ordained and sets other (souls) free till an appointed time. Surely in it are Signs for those who contemplate.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ شُفَعَآءَ‌ؕ قُلۡ اَوَلَوۡ كَانُوۡا لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ شَيْئًا وَّلَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they taken (idols as) intercessors against Allah’s leave? Say: ‘Even though they do not own anything, nor do they have any reason?’

Verses.VerseAr: قُل لِّلَّهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيۡعًا‌ؕ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ ثُمَّ اِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘(The leave for) all intercession rests with Allah alone (which He has specified for His intimate servants). The Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth also belongs to Him alone. Then to Him you will be returned.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا ذُكِرَ اللّٰهُ وَحۡدَهُ اشۡمَاَزَّتۡ قُلُوۡبُ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ‌ ۚ وَاِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖۤ اِذَا هُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when solely Allah is mentioned, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter constrict and recoil with disgust, and when the idols (that they worship) are mentioned apart from Allah, they rejoice all of a sudden.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلِ اللّٰهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ عٰلِمَ الۡغَيۡبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ اَنۡتَ تَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَ عِبَادِكَ فِىۡ مَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Submit: ‘O Allah! Originator of the heavens and the earth! Knower of the unseen and the seen! You alone will judge between Your servants those (matters) in which they used to disagree.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ اَنَّ لِلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مَا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ جَمِيۡعًا وَّمِثۡلَهٗ مَعَهٗ لَافۡتَدَوۡا بِهٖ مِنۡ سُوۡٓءِ الۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ‌ؕ وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَمۡ يَكُوۡنُوۡا يَحۡتَسِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if the wrongdoers possessed all (the wealth and assets) that are on earth and (obtained) the same again in addition, they would ransom themselves with it (for deliverance) from the evil torment on the Day of Resurrection. But there shall appear to them from Allah such a torment as they could never have even imagined.

Verses.VerseAr: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوۡا وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there will appear to them (all) the evildoings which they have earned, and that (torment) will encompass them which they used to laugh at.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِذَا مَسَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ اِذَا خَوَّلۡنٰهُ نِعۡمَةً مِّنَّا ۙ قَالَ اِنَّمَاۤ اُوۡتِيۡتُهٗ عَلٰى عِلۡمٍ‌ؕ بَلۡ هِىَ فِتۡنَةٌ وَّلٰـكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When some suffering touches man, he cries to Us. But when We grant him some favour from Us he starts saying: ‘This favour has come to me on (the basis of my own) knowledge and planning.’ In fact it is a trial but most of them do not know.

Verses.VerseAr: قَدۡ قَالَهَا الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَمَاۤ اَغۡنٰى عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: In truth those who have passed away before them also used to say the same (things). So whatever they earned could not benefit them.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوۡا‌ؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مِنۡ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيۡبُهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوۡا  ۙ وَمَا هُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the evil deeds which they had done fell upon them, and those of them who are engaged in doing wrongs their evil works will (also) catch up with them soon that they have earned, and they cannot prevent (Allah).

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡۤا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And do they not know that Allah gives abundantly to whom He wills and sparingly (to whom He wills)? Surely in that are Signs for those who (truly) believe.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ يٰعِبَادِىَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَسۡرَفُوۡا عَلٰٓى اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ لَا تَقۡنَطُوۡا مِنۡ رَّحۡمَةِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغۡفِرُ الذُّنُوۡبَ جَمِيۡعًا‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘O servants of Mine who have wronged their souls, do not lose hope of Allah’s Mercy. Assuredly, Allah forgives all sins (and excesses). He is certainly Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَنِيۡبُوۡۤا اِلٰى رَبِّكُمۡ وَاَسۡلِمُوۡا لَهٗ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَكُمُ الۡعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنۡصَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And turn to your Lord in repentance and total submission and become thoroughly obedient to Him before the torment comes upon you. Then you will not be helped at all.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاتَّبِعُوۡۤا اَحۡسَنَ مَاۤ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَكُمُ الۡعَذَابُ بَغۡتَةً وَّاَنۡتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And follow the Excellent (Book) that has been revealed to you by your Lord before the torment suddenly comes upon you and you are simply unaware,

Verses.VerseAr: اَنۡ تَقُوۡلَ نَفۡسٌ يّٰحَسۡرَتٰى عَلٰى مَا فَرَّطْتُّ فِىۡ جَنۡۢبِ اللّٰهِ وَاِنۡ كُنۡتُ لَمِنَ السّٰخِرِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Lest) someone should say: ‘Alas! Grief on my lapse and omission in respect of my duty (of obedience) to Allah and I was certainly among those who mocked.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَوۡ تَقُوۡلَ لَوۡ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ هَدٰٮنِىۡ لَكُنۡتُ مِنَ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or should say: ‘If Allah had given me guidance, I would certainly have been of the righteous.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَوۡ تَقُوۡلَ حِيۡنَ تَرَى الۡعَذَابَ لَوۡ اَنَّ لِىۡ كَرَّةً فَاَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or should say on seeing the torment: ‘Could I return to the world but only once, I would then become one among the pious.’

Verses.VerseAr: بَلٰى قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكَ اٰيٰتِىۡ فَكَذَّبۡتَ بِهَا وَاسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ وَكُنۡتَ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The Lord will say:) ‘Yes, no doubt, My Revelations came to you. So you rejected them and showed arrogance and became one of the disbelievers.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ تَرَى الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَبُوۡا عَلَى اللّٰهِ وُجُوۡهُهُمۡ مُّسۡوَدَّةٌ   ؕ اَلَيۡسَ فِىۡ جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوًى لِّلۡمُتَكَبِّرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who have fabricated a lie against Allah you will see them on the Day of Resurrection that their faces are turned black. Is the abode of the arrogant not in Hell?

Verses.VerseAr: وَيُنَجِّىۡ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا بِمَفَازَتِهِمۡ  لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوۡٓءُ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who have adopted Godwariness Allah will deliver them bestowing success on them. No evil will touch them, nor will they grieve at all.

Verses.VerseAr: اَللّٰهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ‌ وَّ هُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ وَّكِيۡلٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah is the Creator of everything and He is Ever-Watchful over everything.

Verses.VerseAr: لَّهٗ مَقَالِيۡدُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: To Him alone belong the keys of the heavens and the earth and those who disbelieve in the Revelations of Allah, it is they who are the losers.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اَفَغَيۡرَ اللّٰهِ تَاۡمُرُوۡٓنِّىۡۤ اَعۡبُدُ اَيُّهَا الۡجٰـهِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘O you ignoramuses, do you ask me to worship someone other than Allah?’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ اُوۡحِىَ اِلَيۡكَ وَاِلَى الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ‌ۚ لَٮِٕنۡ اَشۡرَكۡتَ لَيَحۡبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in truth (this) revelation has been sent to you and to those (Messengers as well) who were (raised) before you: ‘(O man,) if you associate partners with Allah then all your works will go to waste and you will certainly be among the losers.’

Verses.VerseAr: بَلِ اللّٰهَ فَاعۡبُدۡ وَكُنۡ مِّنَ الشّٰكِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, worship Allah and be among the thankful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا قَدَرُوۡا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهٖ ‌ۖ وَالۡاَرۡضُ جَمِيۡعًا قَبۡضَتُهٗ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وَالسَّمٰوٰتُ مَطۡوِيّٰتٌۢ بِيَمِيۡنِهٖ‌ؕ سُبۡحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they did not realize true appreciation and veneration of Allah’s Glory as the appreciation and veneration of His Glory was due. And the whole earth will be in His grip on the Day of Resurrection and all the heavenly spheres will be rolled up in His right hand (i.e. firm hold of His Might). Holy is He and High and Exalted above all what they associate with him.

Verses.VerseAr: وَنُفِخَ فِىۡ الصُّوۡرِ فَصَعِقَ مَنۡ فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَنۡ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ‌ؕ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيۡهِ اُخۡرٰى فَاِذَا هُمۡ قِيَامٌ يَّنۡظُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Trumpet will be blown. Then all the people that are in the heavens and that are in the earth will become senseless except him whom Allah wills. Then the Trumpet will be blown again; so they will stand up gazing all at once.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَشۡرَقَتِ الۡاَرۡضُ بِنُوۡرِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ الۡكِتٰبُ وَجِآىْٓ َٔ بِالنَّبِيّٖنَ وَالشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِىَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the earth (on the Day of Judgment) will be illumined with the Light of its Lord and the Book (of everyone’s deeds) will be laid down. And the Prophets and the witnesses will be brought and judgment will be given between the people with truth and justice. And they will not be done any wrong.

Verses.VerseAr: وَوُفِّيَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ وَهُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And everyone will be given recompense in full for his doings and He Knows full well what they do.

Verses.VerseAr: وَسِيۡقَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡۤا اِلٰى جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا‌ؕ حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءُوۡهَا فُتِحَتۡ اَبۡوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَاۤ اَلَمۡ يَاۡتِكُمۡ رُسُلٌ مِّنۡكُمۡ يَتۡلُوۡنَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّكُمۡ وَيُنۡذِرُوۡنَـكُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هٰذَا‌ؕ قَالُوۡا بَلٰى وَلٰـكِنۡ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ الۡعَذَابِ عَلَى الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who have disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they approach it (Hell), its gates will be opened and its keepers will say to them: ‘Did Messengers not come to you from among yourselves who recited to you the Verses of your Lord and warned you of this Day’s appearance?’ They (the inmates of Hell) will say: ‘Yes, (they came).’ But the command of torment would have been carried out against the disbelievers.

Verses.VerseAr: قِيۡلَ ادۡخُلُوۡۤا اَبۡوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا‌ۚ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى الۡمُتَكَبِّرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It will be said to them: ‘Enter the gates of Hell. (You) will live in it for ever. So how evil is the abode of the arrogant!’

Verses.VerseAr: وَسِيۡقَ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا رَبَّهُمۡ اِلَى الۡجَـنَّةِ زُمَرًا‌ؕ حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءُوۡهَا وَفُتِحَتۡ اَبۡوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ طِبۡتُمۡ فَادۡخُلُوۡهَا خٰلِدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who persisted in fear of Allah will (also) be conducted to Paradise in groups, until when they approach it (Paradise), its doors will have been opened for them (well before) and the keepers of Paradise will say (greeting them): ‘Peace be upon you! Be you glad and rejoicing, so enter it to live here forever.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىۡ صَدَقَنَا وَعۡدَهٗ وَاَوۡرَثَنَا الۡاَرۡضَ نَتَبَوَّاُ مِنَ الۡجَـنَّةِ حَيۡثُ نَشَآءُ  ‌ۚ فَنِعۡمَ اَجۡرُ الۡعٰمِلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they (the residents of Paradise) will say: ‘All praise belongs to Allah alone Who has fulfilled His promise to us and has made us inheritors of the land of Paradise that we may reside in (this) Paradise wherever we desire.’ So how excellent is the reward of those who put piousness to work!

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَرَى الۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةَ حَآفِّيۡنَ مِنۡ حَوۡلِ الۡعَرۡشِ يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ‌ۚ وَقُضِىَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَقِيۡلَ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O Beloved,) you will see the angels all around the Throne in circles glorifying the Lord with His praise and the judgment will be given among (all) the people with the truth and justice and it will be announced: ‘All praise belongs to Allah alone, the Sustainer of all the worlds.’
